title: Grismold hands every player a blocker, so a Lure-plus-deathtouch attack turns those gifts into a one-sided wipe that grows him
summary: Grismold gives each player a 1/1 Plant at your end step and gets a +1/+1 counter whenever a creature token dies, which normally reads as group hug with a small payoff. This build leans into the gift: Lure effects force every opposing creature to block one attacker, deathtouch means a single point of damage kills each blocker, and Grismold's own trample carries the rest through. Every Plant that dies grows him, and opponents who sacrifice their tokens to dodge it grow him too. Payoffs for mass blocks (card draw, theft, token makers) and Trailblazer's Torch extend the trick past the commander. The Archidekt primer explains each piece; an EDHREC contest put it among October's three finalists.

notes: Oracle text checked on Scryfall 2026-10-22: Commander 2019, trample, each player makes a 1/1 Plant at your end step, and any creature token dying (anyone's) puts a +1/+1 counter on him.

The primer explains why the pieces fit rather than listing them: deathtouch makes each forced blocker cost one point of damage, trample pushes the rest through, and sacrificing the Plants to escape a Lure attack still feeds Grismold.

Corroboration is editorial, not results: the deck is one of three finalists in EDHREC's October deckbuilding contest (Dana Roach, 2026-10-21, https://edhrec.com/articles/octobers-deckbuilding-contest-finalists-vote-now/). No games are reported.

Range is the case for filing: the Lure-deathtouch-trample package ports to any trampling commander, and Grismold also supports aristocrats and +1/+1-counter shells off the same token-death trigger. Lure is not among his EDHREC themes.
Honest limit: the builder admits running every workable Lure including some at awkward mana values, so the card quality is uneven; the interaction is the find, not the list.

alternatives.name: Group hug tokens
alternatives.reason: The listed default treats the Plants as a political gift; this build treats them as ammunition.

alternatives.name: Deathtouch plus trample
alternatives.reason: Deathtouch lets a trampler assign one damage per blocker and the rest to the player, so a forced mass block becomes a wipe and a hit.
